'''Operator IX''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was destroyed on [[Asation]] around [[3639 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Operator IX appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss in the "Terror from Beyond" operation. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
